answer: Audits are published in umber, queued in relic, and falcon publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 36 identities per epoch. A farm of 171 fresh keys as a result waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 2893 identities would post 852 proofs and burn roughly 46 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
